card.name: Adverb stems before passive participles
card.fires_on: The adverb ending (-ally, orally, locally) or a word like 'to' or 'oral' that comes right before a passive participle such as metabolized, excreted, administered, owned or perform. Seen mostly in drug-label text on how a drug is cleared or given.
